items.title_cn: SAP衍生外泌体通过FKBP5介导抑制RIPK3/MLKL信号促进肠道屏障损伤
items.title_en: SAP ‐Derived Exosomes Promote Intestinal Barrier Injury Through FKBP5‐Mediated Suppression of RIPK 3/ MLKL Signaling
items.abstract_cn: 探讨循环外泌体在重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）肠屏障功能障碍中的作用，并阐明其潜在分子机制，重点关注Fkbp5介导的RIPK3/MLKL坏死性凋亡信号抑制。从早期SAP患者和健康对照者中分离血清外泌体，并通过透射电子显微镜（TEM）和纳米颗粒跟踪分析（NTA）进行表征。通过反复腹腔注射雨蛙素后给予脂多糖（LPS）诱导SAP小鼠模型，并进行外泌体释放抑制剂GW4869、Fkbp5抑制剂SAFit2和RIPK3抑制剂GSK872的干预实验。采用组织学染色、免疫组化、血清生物标志物检测、肠道通透性试验和转录组测序评估外泌体和Fkbp5对SAP相关肠损伤的影响。在GW4869处理后进行外泌体再回输实验，并通过E-钙黏蛋白双重免疫荧光染色评估膜相关p-MLKL。SAP患者血清外泌体水平显著升高。来自SAP小鼠的循环外泌体促进肠上皮屏障破坏和炎症反应。GW4869处理显著改善胰腺和肠道组织病理学损伤，降低血清炎症标志物和肠道通透性，并下调肠道组织中Fkbp5表达。转录组分析和qRT-PCR验证显示，Fkbp5在SAP小鼠肠道中显著上调。抑制Fkbp5可恢复RIPK3和MLKL的磷酸化，减轻SAP小鼠的肠损伤，而FKBP12抑制未产生保护作用。在体外，SAP来源的外泌体抑制肠上皮细胞中的坏死性凋亡信号，而GW4869逆转了这种抑制。回输SAP来源的外泌体（而非对照来源的外泌体）部分恢复了GW4869处理后的胰腺和肠道损伤，伴随肠道FKBP5表达增加、Occludin和Claudin-1表达降低以及膜相关p-MLKL减少。此外，GSK872抑制RIPK3加重了SAP小鼠的胰腺和肠道损伤。这些发现表明，重症急性胰腺炎中的循环外泌体可能上调Fkbp5，从而抑制坏死性凋亡通路并由此破坏肠道稳态。SAP中的循环外泌体通过上调Fkbp5加剧肠屏障功能障碍，而Fkbp5抑制RIPK3/MLKL坏死性凋亡信号通路。靶向外泌体-Fkbp5轴可能为SAP相关肠损伤提供治疗策略。
items.abstract_en: To investigate the role of circulating exosomes in intestinal barrier dysfunction during severe acute pancreatitis (SAP) and to elucidate the underlying molecular mechanisms, with a particular focus on Fkbp5-mediated suppression of RIPK3/MLKL necroptotic signaling. Serum exosomes were isolated from early-stage SAP patients and healthy controls and characterized by transmission electron microscopy (TEM) and nanoparticle tracking analysis (NTA). A mouse model of SAP was induced by repeated intraperitoneal injections of caerulein followed by lipopolysaccharide (LPS) administration, and interventions with the exosome release inhibitor GW4869, the Fkbp5 inhibitor SAFit2, and the RIPK3 inhibitor GSK872 were performed. Histological staining, immunohistochemistry, serum biomarker assays, intestinal permeability tests, and transcriptomic sequencing were used to evaluate the effects of exosomes and Fkbp5 on intestinal injury associated with SAP. An exosome readministration experiment was performed after GW4869 treatment, and membrane-associated p-MLKL was assessed by dual immunofluorescence staining with E-cadherin. Serum exosome levels were significantly elevated in SAP patients. Circulating exosomes from SAP mice promoted intestinal epithelial barrier disruption and inflammatory responses. GW4869 treatment significantly improved pancreatic and intestinal histopathological injury, reduced serum inflammatory markers and intestinal permeability, and downregulated Fkbp5 expression in intestinal tissues. Transcriptomic analysis and qRT-PCR validation revealed that Fkbp5 was markedly upregulated in the intestines of SAP mice. Inhibition of Fkbp5 restored the phosphorylation of RIPK3 and MLKL, attenuating intestinal injury in SAP mice, while FKBP12 inhibition conferred no protective effect. In vitro, SAP-derived exosomes suppressed necroptosis signaling in intestinal epithelial cells, whereas GW4869 reversed this suppression. Readministration of SAP-derived, but not control-derived, exosomes partially restored pancreatic and intestinal injury after GW4869 treatment, accompanied by increased intestinal FKBP5 expression, reduced Occludin and Claudin-1 expression, and decreased membrane-associated p-MLKL. Furthermore, inhibition of RIPK3 by GSK872 aggravated pancreatic and intestinal injury in SAP mice. These findings suggest that circulating exosomes in severe acute pancreatitis may upregulate Fkbp5, thereby suppressing the necroptotic pathway and consequently disrupting intestinal homeostasis. Circulating exosomes in SAP exacerbate intestinal barrier dysfunction by upregulating Fkbp5, which suppresses the RIPK3/MLKL necroptotic signaling pathway. Targeting the exosome-Fkbp5 axis may offer a therapeutic strategy for SAP-related intestinal injury.
items.summary_cn: 该研究发现重症急性胰腺炎（SAP）患者血清外泌体水平显著升高，SAP来源的外泌体通过上调肠道Fkbp5表达、抑制RIPK3/MLKL坏死性凋亡信号通路，从而破坏肠道屏障并加重肠道损伤；靶向外泌体-Fkbp5轴可能为SAP相关肠损伤提供治疗策略。

items.title_cn: 氨甲环酸的使用与非临床重要非静脉曲张性上消化道出血危重患者进展为临床重要出血：一项回顾性队列研究
items.title_en: Tranexamic acid use and progression to clinically important bleeding in critically ill patients with non-clinically important non-variceal upper gastrointestinal bleeding: a retrospective cohort study
items.abstract_cn: 氨甲环酸（TXA）广泛用于减少围手术期及出血性疾病中的出血，但其在上消化道出血（UGIB）中的作用仍存在争议。本单中心回顾性队列研究评估了TXA使用是否与危重症患者中非临床重要非静脉曲张性UGIB进展为临床重要消化道出血（GIB）的减少相关。纳入2018年至2022年间发生非临床重要非静脉曲张性UGIB的成人ICU患者。其中，154例在出血发生后24小时内接受TXA治疗的患者（平均用药时长1.71 ± 1.42天；平均总剂量2.12 ± 2.36 g）与1,660例既未接受TXA也未接受其他止血药物的患者进行了比较。经倾向性评分匹配后，分析了154对匹配病例。TXA组与非TXA组之间进展为临床重要GIB的比例在匹配前（5.8% vs. 5.7%；P =0.951，95% CI：0.450–1.707）和匹配后（5.8% vs. 7.8%；P =0.664，95% CI：0.562–3.164）均无显著差异；探索性单因素条件logistic回归分析显示，TXA使用与该结局无关（OR 1.333，95% CI 0.562–3.164；P =0.514）。在匹配队列中，TXA与内镜检查需求、输血需求、住院时长、院内死亡率或血栓并发症方面均无显著差异。逆概率治疗加权分析对主要结局得出一致结果（5.1% vs. 5.8%；P =0.418，95% CI：0.840–1.522）。在非临床重要非静脉曲张性UGIB的危重症患者中，TXA使用与进展为临床重要GIB的统计学可检测的减少或主要临床结局的改善均无关。在该人群中常规经验性使用TXA应谨慎对待。
items.abstract_en: Tranexamic acid (TXA) is widely used to reduce bleeding in perioperative and hemorrhagic conditions, but its role in upper gastrointestinal bleeding (UGIB) remains controversial. This single-center retrospective cohort study evaluated whether TXA use was associated with reduced progression to clinically important gastrointestinal bleeding (GIB) in critically ill patients with non-clinically important non-variceal UGIB. Adult ICU patients who developed non-clinically important non-variceal UGIB between 2018 and 2022 were included. Among them, 154 patients receiving TXA within 24 h after bleeding onset (mean duration 1.71 ± 1.42 days; mean total dose 2.12 ± 2.36 g) were compared with 1,660 patients who received neither TXA nor other hemostatic agents. After propensity score matching, 154 matched pairs were analyzed. Progression to clinically important GIB did not differ significantly between the TXA and non- TXA groups before matching (5.8% vs. 5.7%; P =0.951, 95% CI: 0.450–1.707) or after matching (5.8% vs. 7.8%; P =0.664, 95% CI: 0.562–3.164); Exploratory univariate conditional logistic regression analysis showed that TXA use was not associated with this outcome (OR 1.333, 95% CI 0.562–3.164; P =0.514). In the matched cohort, TXA was not associated with significant differences in endoscopy requirement, transfusion requirement, hospital length of stay, in-hospital mortality, or thrombotic complications. Inverse probability of treatment weighting analysis yielded consistent results for the primary outcome (5.1% vs. 5.8%; P =0.418, 95% CI: 0.840–1.522). In critically ill patients with non-clinically important non-variceal UGIB, TXA use was not associated with a statistically detectable reduction in progression to clinically important GIB or improvements in major clinical outcomes. Routine empirical use of TXA in this population should be approached with caution.
items.summary_cn: 在重症监护病房的非临床重要非静脉曲张性上消化道出血患者中，氨甲环酸的使用与进展为临床重要消化道出血的风险降低无显著关联，且未改善内镜需求、输血需求、住院时长、院内死亡率或血栓并发症等主要临床结局。因此，该人群常规经验性使用氨甲环酸应谨慎。

items.title_cn: 复发性急性胰腺炎患者原发性甲状旁腺功能亢进症的延迟诊断：一例病例报告
items.title_en: Delayed diagnosis of primary hyperparathyroidism in a patient with recurrent acute pancreatitis: a case report
items.abstract_cn: 原发性甲状旁腺功能亢进症（PHPT）是一种不常见但与临床相关的代谢性疾病，可与急性胰腺炎相关。我们报告一例32岁男性患者，在约4年内反复发生急性胰腺炎，最终发现其合并存在PHPT。长期大量饮用啤酒和胆石症是重要的竞争性病因因素。尽管无法从病历中可靠地量化饮酒的确切量和频率，但患者在导致PHPT诊断的住院之前已近期停止饮酒。系列腹部超声和计算机断层扫描未显示胆总管结石或胆管扩张，随后的随访影像学检查也未显示持续性胆道梗阻的证据。对既往实验室结果的回顾性审查发现反复出现高钙血症和低磷血症，但此前未促使进行甲状旁腺功能评估。后续检测显示甲状旁腺激素水平显著升高，甲状旁腺闪烁显像和颈部超声定位到右侧下甲状旁腺病变。行右侧下甲状旁腺切除术，组织病理学检查证实为甲状旁腺腺瘤。术后第1天，甲状旁腺激素显著降至1.7 pg/mL，血清钙为2.57 mmol/L。在长期临床随访中，包括术后约1年和2年的电话随访以及最近一次联系时，患者一般状况良好，无反复腹痛或急性胰腺炎发作。本病例提示，对于反复发作胰腺炎并伴有持续性高钙血症的患者，即使存在其他潜在病因因素，也应考虑PHPT。
items.abstract_en: Primary hyperparathyroidism (PHPT) is an uncommon but clinically relevant metabolic condition associated with acute pancreatitis. We report a 32-year-old man with recurrent acute pancreatitis over approximately 4 years in whom coexisting PHPT was eventually recognized. Long-term heavy beer consumption and cholelithiasis represented important competing etiological factors. Although the exact amount and frequency of alcohol consumption could not be reliably quantified from the medical record, the patient had recently stopped drinking before the hospitalization leading to the diagnosis of PHPT. Serial abdominal ultrasonography and computed tomography did not demonstrate choledocholithiasis or biliary duct dilatation, and subsequent follow-up imaging showed no evidence of persistent biliary obstruction. Retrospective review of previous laboratory results revealed recurrent hypercalcemia and hypophosphatemia that had not prompted evaluation of parathyroid function. Subsequent testing demonstrated markedly elevated parathyroid hormone levels, and parathyroid scintigraphy and neck ultrasonography localized a right inferior parathyroid lesion. Right inferior parathyroidectomy was performed, and histopathological examination confirmed a parathyroid adenoma. On postoperative day 1, parathyroid hormone decreased markedly to 1.7 pg/mL, with serum calcium of 2.57 mmol/L. During long-term clinical follow-up, including telephone follow-up at approximately 1 and 2 years after surgery and at the most recent contact, the patient remained in good general condition without recurrent abdominal pain or acute pancreatitis. This case suggests that PHPT should be considered in patients with recurrent pancreatitis and persistent hypercalcemia, even when other potential etiological factors are present.
items.summary_cn: 本文报道一例32岁男性复发性急性胰腺炎患者，在长期大量饮用啤酒和胆石症等竞争性病因存在的情况下，最终通过回顾既往实验室结果发现反复高钙血症和低磷血症，进而确诊原发性甲状旁腺功能亢进（甲状旁腺腺瘤），行甲状旁腺切除术后长期随访无胰腺炎复发。提示对复发性胰腺炎伴持续性高钙血症的患者，即使存在其他潜在病因，也应考虑PHPT。

items.title_cn: 海藻糖通过调节自噬相关标志物Beclin-1、LC3-II和p62/SQSTM1的表达减轻实验性L-精氨酸诱导的小鼠急性胰腺炎
items.title_en: Trehalose Attenuates Experimental L-Arginine-Induced Acute Pancreatitis in Mice by Modulating the Expression of Autophagy-Related Markers: Beclin-1, LC3-II, and p62/SQSTM1
items.summary_cn: 该论文标题表明海藻糖可通过调节自噬相关标志物Beclin-1、LC3-II和p62/SQSTM1的表达，减轻L-精氨酸诱导的小鼠实验性急性胰腺炎。由于未提供摘要，无法进一步总结具体发现。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
